sources.entry: Lancache ⚠ - LAN Party game caching made easy. (Source Code) MIT Docker/Shell
LanCache | LAN party game download cache for Steam, Epic, Battle.net and more

summary.one_liner: A monolithic Docker container for caching game downloads on a LAN party network, built on the LanCache.net project.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and mostly points to external documentation on the LanCache.net website for setup and usage. It describes this repository as the monolithic (single-container) packaging of the LanCache.net game download cache. It states that the project is based on original configs from ansible-lanparty. The README itself does not list specific features, configuration options, or supported game platforms beyond the metadata. The support page is referenced for troubleshooting before opening issues.
use_cases: cache game downloads for a LAN party
reduce repeated game downloads on a local network
set up a game download cache in Docker
speed up game updates across multiple machines at an event
how_to_run: See the documentation on the LanCache.net website (linked from the README); the README itself gives no install commands
notable: Single-container (monolithic) packaging of the LanCache.net game download cache
Derived from original configs from ansible-lanparty
Documentation hosted externally on the LanCache.net website
caveats: README is minimal; setup details live in external documentation not included here
Awesome-selfhosted marks the project with a warning symbol, indicating a caveat noted in that list (details not given in the README)
keywords: share game downloads on local network
